The attached image is the SINGLE definitive art-style reference. Create a NEW illustration that genuinely looks painted by the SAME ARTIST for the SAME GAME. Study its rendering closely: sophisticated polished illustrated city, finely drawn realistic architecture and vehicles, smooth soft gradients on cream/apricot facades, nuanced contact shadows and long soft daylight shadows, precise small mechanical details, elegant natural vegetation, appealing fully modeled character faces and clothing folds. The image feels richly illustrated and three-dimensional through DRAWING and SHADING, NOT through a 3D renderer. Use the SAME elevated bird's-eye three-quarter camera and same relative scale of environment. No flat vector clipart, no simple pictograms, no thick comic ink, no simplified schematic scenery. NO thick black strokes. Quiet fine gray contours selectively, surfaces separated primarily by shading/color. All asphalt/concrete LIGHT NEUTRAL GRAY, all windows and vehicle windshields PALE LIGHT SKY BLUE. Keep saturated blue/orange only as considered accents. Crisp professionally art-directed 2D game key art, with the same density of meaningful detail and level of finish as the attachment.

NEW SCENE: A modern autumn river port on the Ob, seen from the same overhead camera as reference city. Landscape16:9. A warm cream cargo warehouse on the upper left with two loading doors, subtle facade panel seams, blue awning, warm beige crates and pallets. A smaller cream/apricot dispatch office to its right with sign Cyrillic 'ПРУ', pale blue windows and a large readable open window/cutaway revealing ONE operator Ivan at his desk in navy workwear and orange high-vis vest. TWO elegant technically detailed dock portal cranes stand to right: nearest one larger, its cabin empty; second farther away on its own grounded quay, ONE operator Petr seated at its cabin in PPE. Real lattice booms, coherent pivot joints, cables, hooks and multiwheel crane chassis. Both hooks hang idle, no lifting cargo. Exactly two people total, no crowd.

A long open blue-gray cargo barge floats immediately below the quay in lower-right river area, completely inside frame, with several long steel pipes already resting on its deck, strapped down. Beside them is clearly visible empty deck space for future gift. Water with subtle beautiful pale-blue ripples and drawn reflections. Bollards and mooring ropes keep it believable. On light gray quay in foreground center-left a small enclosed low autonomous electric tow tractor (no steering wheel, no driver's seat, lidar mast) tows a small wheeled cart holding ONE ordinary orange wrapped carton with small white CAMERA PICTOGRAM. The gift is a rectangular BOX, not an enormous actual camera. Show enough clear space around it to serve as interaction target.

Sparse autumn trees, trimmed shrubs and a low distant riverbank, restrained yellow bollards, warehouse vents, tidy coils, ladder, railings and protective details. Composition as legible as reference city, large distinct structures with realistic proportions, refined small features, bright neutral daylight. No huge pasted foreground portraits. No changes to scenario: warehouse, office, exactly2cranes, exactly2operators, exactly1gift carton on quay, exactly1barge with pipes. No trucks copied from city reference, no road numbers, no UI. Rich soft polished rendering matching attached reference, not merely its colors.
